name: llm-inference-calculator
description: Static performance model for LLM inference: VRAM feasibility + ideal TTFT/TPOT/throughput

scripts.demo: tsc examples/demo.ts src/core/*.ts --outDir dist-demo --rootDir . --module esnext --target es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --strict --skipLibCheck && node dist-demo/examples/demo.js
scripts.calibrate: tsc examples/calibrate.ts src/core/*.ts src/data/*.ts --outDir dist-demo --rootDir . --module esnext --target es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --strict --skipLibCheck && node dist-demo/examples/calibrate.js
